title: FoundationDB's Flow – Bringing Actor-Based Concurrency to C++11
summary: FoundationDB's Flow is Apple's custom actor-based concurrency framework built for C++11, designed to simplify building highly concurrent and distributed systems by providing lightweight actors that handle asynchronous operations without traditional threading complexities.
problem_solved: Solves the complexity of managing traditional thread-based concurrency in high-performance distributed systems, reducing issues like deadlocks and race conditions.
why_valuable: It enables developers to write safer, more maintainable concurrent code in C++ while achieving performance comparable to manual thread management, making distributed database development more accessible.
